data.name: The Sewer
data.detailed_description:
Poverty and unemployment is at an all time high. Wealth is concentrated in the hands of a few. Artificial intelligence is on the rise and you sit at the bottom of the food chain. When a job offer to explore a few sewers with surprisingly high pay appears, you jump at the opportunity. What you don't know is that you won't be alone. Something is constantly stalking you. With only a limited amount of energy to sprint away and a dying flashlight battery, you must finish your job before it finishes you. 

Descend. Survive. Uncover the truth.

The Sewer is a first-person survival horror game set in the crumbling dark beneath the city. You have one job: map six procedurally generated sewer systems, each more twisted and lethal than the last. Your flashlight is your lifeline — and your countdown clock. Every second of light you burn is a second closer to being alone in the dark with whatever's down there.

Something is stalking you through the tunnels. Sprint is limited, stamina doesn't come back for free, and the things hunting you learn as you go deeper. React fast, manage your resources, and never assume you're alone.

As you push further into the sewers, the fragments start to add up. The deeper you go, the more the sewers reveal, and the less you'll want to know.

6 procedural sewers. Rising difficulty. One flashlight standing between you and the dark.

This game was created using Godot

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 560 (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 6-core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 (6GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: any
